summary: An excerpt from a near-future novel (Book 1, part 4) in which a student narrator describes surveillance in his school: gait-recognition cameras that replaced banned face-recognition cameras, and the SchoolBook laptops that log keystrokes and traffic. He describes how he cracked his SchoolBook to hide programs from the Board of Ed's integrity checks, and how he uses the secret messenger IMParanoid to plan with his friend Darryl skipping class to chase clues in the alternate reality game Harajuku Fun Madness.
one_line: A student narrator resists school surveillance by cracking his SchoolBook laptop and planning to skip class for the game Harajuku Fun Madness.
key_facts: The school installed gait-recognition cameras about a year before the excerpt, after a court ruled face-recognition cameras unconstitutional.
The narrator loves the gait-recognition cameras for their sheer idiocy and believes they cannot reliably tell one person's walk from another.
The SchoolBooks were school-issued laptops that logged every keystroke, watched network traffic for suspicious keywords, and counted every click.
The SchoolBooks were given out in the narrator's junior year, and the novelty wore off within a couple of months.
The SchoolBooks showed a never-ending parade of obnoxious ads.
The narrator cracked his SchoolBook within a month of its arrival by downloading a DVD image, burning it, and booting the machine while holding several keys.
The crack installed hidden programs that survived the Board of Ed's daily remote integrity checks.
The narrator must download software updates to get around the Board's latest tests.
IMParanoid is a secret instant messenger the narrator uses for off-the-record discussion during class.
Darryl proposes skipping school to follow a clue for Harajuku Fun Madness, and the narrator says he will be expelled if he ditches a third time.
Harajuku Fun Madness is an alternate reality game (ARG) about a gang of Japanese fashion-teens who discovered a healing gem at the temple in Harajuku.
In the game's story, the teens are hunted by evil monks and the Yakuza.
Ms Galvez is the teacher who welcomes the narrator back to class.
The narrator plans to get the whole team out after school, with lunch and study hall giving two hours before anyone misses them.
